info.title: StellarKraal API
info.description:
Livestock-backed micro-lending API on Stellar/Soroban. Write endpoints return an unsigned XDR transaction the client must sign with Freighter and submit to the Stellar network.

**Rate limits:** Per-IP limits apply (global, auth, and write tiers). See the [rate limits guide](../docs/guides/rate-limits.md) for limits, headers, and retry behavior. See also the [API quickstart](../docs/guides/api-quickstart.md).

**Changelog:** All API-level additions and breaking changes are documented in the [API Changelog](../docs/api-changelog.md).

get.description: Returns a random hex challenge string. The client must sign it with their Stellar keypair and submit it to POST /auth/login.

schema.description: Object containing the hex challenge string.

post.description: Verifies the ed25519 signature over the challenge. Returns a short-lived JWT access token (15 min) and a refresh token.

requestBody.description: Stellar public key, hex-encoded ed25519 signature, and the challenge string obtained from GET /auth/challenge.

signedChallenge.description: Signed challenge nonce and ed25519 signature

expiresIn.description: Access token validity period in seconds

post.description: Reads the refresh token from the refreshToken httpOnly cookie, validates it, and issues a new access token and rotated cookie. Old token is added to blocklist to prevent reuse attacks.

get.description: Returns the current health status of the API service, including version, uptime, Soroban RPC reachability, and connection pool statistics. Returns 200 when healthy or 503 when degraded.
Confirms the process is running and can accept requests. No dependency checks; Kubernetes restarts the pod only when this fails.
Confirms external dependencies (database, Soroban RPC) are reachable. Kubernetes stops routing traffic when this returns 503.

Returns the health status of each infrastructure component: database, Soroban RPC, and disk space. Returns 200 when all components are healthy or 503 when one or more are degraded. Disk is considered degraded when free space falls below 500 MB.

disk.description: Disk space status (degraded below 500 MB free).
Disk space status (degraded below 500 MB free).

post.description: Builds an unsigned Soroban transaction to register livestock as on-chain collateral. The client must sign the returned XDR with Freighter and submit it to the Stellar network.

requestBody.description: Livestock collateral details including owner wallet, animal type, count, and appraised value.

post.description: Builds unsigned Soroban transactions for up to 50 livestock collateral registrations in a single request. Returns an array of unsigned XDR transactions in the same order as the input items.

requestBody.description: An array of 1–50 collateral registration items to process in batch.

200.description: Array of unsigned XDR transactions, one per item in input order

post.description: Creates a livestock collateral record from JSON data or a multipart registration with animal details and a JPEG or PNG image. This does not submit an on-chain transaction; use POST /collateral/register for on-chain registration.

requestBody.description: Collateral record details including animal type, count, and appraised value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of collateral records. Supports filtering by owner wallet address and animal type. Results are ordered by creation date descending.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Filter by Stellar public key of the collateral owner.

get.description: Returns a single collateral record by its unique identifier. Returns 404 if the record does not exist.

patch.description: Updates one or more fields on an existing collateral record. At least one of animal_type, count, or appraised_value must be provided. Returns the updated record.

requestBody.description: Fields to update. At least one field must be provided.

delete.description: Marks a collateral record as deleted without removing it from the database. The record can be restored via PATCH /collateral/{id}/restore. Returns the deletion confirmation.

put.description: Sets the appraised value for a collateral record. The new value must be a positive integer representing token base units. Returns the updated record.

requestBody.description: New appraised value for the collateral.

appraised_value.description: New appraised value in token base units.

patch.description: Restores a previously soft-deleted collateral record, removing its deleted_at timestamp. Returns 409 if the collateral is currently pledged to an active loan.

409.description: Collateral is pledged to an active loan

post.description: Builds an unsigned Soroban transaction to request a new loan against registered collateral. Consider supplying an `Idempotency-Key` header on retries to avoid accidentally submitting duplicate loan requests.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated UUID v4 key. If supplied, the server stores the response for 24 hours and returns the original on replay with `X-Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

requestBody.description: Loan request payload including borrower public key, collateral ID, and requested amount.

post.description: Builds an unsigned Soroban transaction to repay part or all of an existing loan. Requires an Idempotency-Key header to prevent duplicate submissions. The client must sign the returned XDR and submit it to the Stellar network.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated unique key for idempotent replay

requestBody.description: Repayment details including borrower wallet, loan ID, and repayment amount.

X-Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present with value `true` when the response was served from the idempotency cache

post.description: Builds an unsigned Soroban transaction to liquidate a loan whose health factor has fallen below the liquidation threshold. The liquidator repays part of the loan and receives the pledged collateral. Returns 400 with the current health factor if the loan is not yet liquidatable.

requestBody.description: Liquidation details including liquidator wallet, loan ID, and repayment amount.

post.description: Simulates a repayment and returns principal/interest/fee breakdown and projected health factor. Does not submit a transaction.

requestBody.description: Loan ID and proposed repayment amount for simulation.

get.description: Returns the on-chain Soroban ScVal representation of a loan by its numeric ID. Use GET /loans for paginated listing.

delete.description: Marks a loan record as deleted without removing it from the database. The record can be restored via POST /admin/restore/loans/{id}.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of loan records.

**Cursor-based pagination (recommended)** — Pass `cursor=<nextCursor>` from the previous response. Provides stable, efficient traversal using `(createdAt, id)` as the composite key. `total` and `page` are omitted in cursor mode; use `nextCursor` and `hasMore` instead.

**Offset-based pagination (legacy)** — Use `page` and `pageSize`/`limit` parameters. Remains fully supported for backward compatibility. Returns `total` and `page` fields.

Unpaginated requests (without any pagination params) are deprecated and return `Deprecation`/`Sunset` headers.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque page token returned as `nextCursor` in a previous response. When provided, cursor-based pagination is used. Mutually exclusive with `page`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for offset-based pagination (1-indexed). Ignored when `cursor` is supplied.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of records per page (1–100). Applies to both cursor and offset modes.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Alias for `pageSize` (legacy). `pageSize` takes precedence when both are provided.

parameters.name: borrowerAddress
parameters.description: Filter loans belonging to this Stellar public key.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO 8601 start date for `createdAt` range filter (inclusive).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO 8601 end date for `createdAt` range filter (inclusive).

get.description: Returns aggregate loan metrics scoped to the authenticated borrower, including total loans by status and total loan value. Responses are cached for 30 seconds.
Returns the health factor scaled by 10 000. Values ≥ 10 000 are healthy; < 10 000 are eligible for liquidation.

post.description: Clears the in-memory appraisal value cache so the next collateral query fetches fresh values. Typically called after an oracle price feed update.

invalidated.description: Always true when the cache is cleared.

post.description: Registers a new webhook URL to receive event notifications. Optionally enables payload encryption. Returns the created webhook record with a unique ID.

requestBody.description: Webhook URL to register. Optionally include encrypt: true for payload encryption.

url.description: HTTPS URL to receive webhook POST requests.

encrypt.description: If true, encrypts the webhook payload with a shared secret.

delete.description: Permanently removes a registered webhook by its ID. Returns 204 with no body on success, or 404 if the webhook does not exist.

post.description: Receives AWS SNS notifications (SubscriptionConfirmation and Notification). Used for backup failure alerts. Automatically confirms SNS subscriptions and fires alerts on backup job failures.

get.description: Returns all registered webhook URLs and their metadata. Requires admin privileges.
Returns recent webhook delivery attempts including event type, HTTP status, and timestamp. Requires admin privileges.

schema.description: Array of webhook delivery log entries.

get.description: Returns the current status of database migrations, including which migrations have been applied and which are pending. Requires admin privileges.

status.description: Map of migration names to their applied/pending status.

get.description: Returns all collateral records that have been soft-deleted (deleted_at is set). Useful for auditing and recovery. Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Admin endpoint to restore a soft-deleted collateral record by clearing its deleted_at timestamp. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: Returns all loan records that have been soft-deleted. Useful for auditing and recovery. Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Admin endpoint to restore a soft-deleted loan record by clearing its deleted_at timestamp. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: Returns aggregated platform metrics: total users, loans, collateral, TVL, and active loan count. Admin role required. Response cached for 60 seconds.
Returns a paginated list of transaction records. Supports filtering by borrower, transaction type, status, and date range.

parameters.name: borrower
parameters.description: Filter by borrower Stellar public key.

get.description: Returns a single transaction record by its unique identifier, including borrower, type, status, amount, and creation timestamp.
Polls the Soroban RPC for the confirmation status of a submitted transaction by its 64-character hex hash. Returns pending, success, or failed. Rate-limited to 10 requests per second.

ledger.description: Ledger number where the transaction was confirmed (present when status is success).

errorCode.description: Soroban error code (present when status is failed).

get.description: Returns the notification preferences, language, and currency settings for the specified wallet address. Returns default settings if none have been configured.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Stellar public key of the user.

put.description: Replaces the user settings for the specified wallet address. Only provided fields are updated; unspecified fields retain their current values.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Stellar public key of the user.

requestBody.description: Settings fields to update (at least one field required).

post.summary: Submit pre-signed XDR for loan repayment
post.description: Accepts client pre-signed Soroban XDR directly and submits it to the Stellar RPC network.

requestBody.description: Object containing the base64-encoded signed XDR transaction string.

schema.description: Repayment payload with signed XDR string.
Transaction submission result containing transaction hash and status.

get.description: Returns the caller's own profile, including wallet address, display name, join date, and loan/collateral counts. First login auto-creates the underlying profile record.

joinedAt.description: ISO timestamp the profile was first created

loanCount.description: Total number of loans belonging to this user

collateralCount.description: Total number of collateral records owned by this user

404.description: No profile record exists for this user yet

bearerAuth.description: HS256 JWT issued by POST /api/auth/login. Required on all POST, PUT, DELETE, and PATCH requests except /api/auth/* endpoints. Pass as: Authorization: Bearer <token>

LoginRequest.description: Stellar wallet login request. The client obtains a challenge from GET /auth/challenge, signs it with their ed25519 keypair, and submits the signature here.

signature.description: Hex-encoded ed25519 signature over the challenge bytes

TokenResponse.description: JWT token pair returned on successful login or token refresh.

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT access token (15 min TTL). Pass in Authorization header.

refreshToken.description: Long-lived refresh token (7 days TTL). Used with POST /auth/refresh to obtain a new pair.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned for all error responses. The error field contains a human-readable message; code contains a machine-readable error category.

error.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong.

details.description: Additional error details, typically field-level validation messages.

items.description: Error message for a specific field.

HealthResponse.description: Service health status returned by GET /health. Includes version info, uptime, RPC reachability, and connection pool statistics.

rpcReachable.description: Whether the Soroban RPC endpoint is reachable.

circuitBreaker.description: Circuit breaker state for upstream connections.

healthy.description: Whether the circuit breaker is in a healthy state.

pool.description: Connection pool statistics (active, idle, total connections).

RegisterCollateralRequest.description: Request to register livestock collateral on-chain via a Soroban transaction.

animal_type.description: Type of livestock (e.g. cattle, goat, sheep).

count.description: Number of animals in this collateral group.

appraised_value.description: Total appraised value in token base units

BatchRegisterCollateralRequest.description: Batch request to register multiple livestock collateral items on-chain in a single call.

BatchRegisterCollateralResponse.description: Response containing an array of unsigned XDR transactions, one per input item, in the same order.

results.description: Unsigned XDR transactions, one per input item in order

V1MultipartCollateralRequest.description: Multipart request to create a collateral record with livestock details and a verification image.

age.description: Age of the animal in years.

weight.description: Weight of the animal in kilograms.

image.description: JPEG or PNG image no larger than 5 MiB.

V1CreateCollateralRequest.description: Request to create a collateral record in the database without an on-chain transaction.

animal_type.description: Type of livestock (e.g. cattle, goat, sheep).

count.description: Number of animals in this collateral group.

appraised_value.description: Appraised value in token base units.

V1UpdateCollateralRequest.description: Partial update request for an existing collateral record. At least one field must be provided.

appraised_value.description: Updated appraised value in token base units.

CollateralRecord.description: A livestock collateral record stored in the database. Includes identification, ownership, valuation, and soft-delete status.

owner.description: Stellar public key of the collateral owner.

animal_type.description: Type of livestock (e.g. cattle, goat, sheep).

age_years.description: Age of the animal in years for multipart registrations.

weight_kg.description: Weight of the animal in kilograms for multipart registrations.

photo_url.description: Path to the uploaded verification image.

count.description: Number of animals in this collateral group.

appraised_value.description: Appraised value in token base units.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the record was soft-deleted, or null if active.

CollateralPage.description: Paginated response containing a list of collateral records with total count and pagination metadata.

data.description: Array of collateral records for the current page.

total.description: Total number of collateral records matching the query.

LoanRequestBody.description: Request to create a new loan backed by livestock collateral.

collateral_id.description: Numeric ID of the collateral backing this loan.

amount.description: Gross loan amount in token base units

LoanRepayBody.description: Request to repay part or all of an existing loan.

borrower.description: Stellar public key of the borrower repaying the loan.

loan_id.description: Numeric ID of the loan to repay.

amount.description: Repayment amount in token base units.

LoanLiquidateBody.description: Request to liquidate an undercollateralised loan.

liquidator.description: Stellar public key of the liquidator.

loan_id.description: Numeric ID of the loan to liquidate.

repay_amount.description: Amount the liquidator will repay in token base units.

RepaymentPreviewRequest.description: Request to simulate a loan repayment and preview the breakdown.

loan_id.description: Numeric ID of the loan to simulate repayment for.

amount.description: Proposed repayment amount in token base units.

RepaymentPreviewResponse.description: Simulated repayment breakdown showing how the repayment amount is allocated across principal, interest, and fees.

loan_id.description: Numeric ID of the loan being simulated.

repayment_amount.description: Total repayment amount in token base units.

breakdown.description: Allocation breakdown of the repayment amount.

remaining_balance.description: Remaining loan balance after this repayment.

projected_health_factor_bps.description: Projected health factor after repayment, scaled by 10 000. Null if loan would be fully repaid.

fully_repaid.description: True if this repayment would fully satisfy the loan.

LoanPage.description: Paginated response containing a list of loan records. Fields differ slightly between cursor and offset pagination modes — see `paginationMode`.

data.description: Array of loan records for the current page.

total.description: Total number of loan records matching the query (offset mode only; -1 in cursor mode).

page.description: Current page number, 1-indexed (offset mode only; -1 in cursor mode).

limit.description: Effective page size used for this request.

paginationMode.description: Indicates which pagination strategy was used. `cursor` when `?cursor=` was supplied; `offset` otherwise.

nextCursor.description: Opaque token to pass as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page (cursor mode only). `null` when there are no more records.

hasMore.description: Whether more records exist after the current page (cursor mode only).

LoanSummaryResponse.description: Borrower-specific loan portfolio summary with aggregate metrics.

totalLoans.description: Total number of loans for the borrower.

totalLoanValueXLM.description: Total value of all loans in XLM.

XdrResponse.description: An unsigned Soroban transaction encoded as Base64 XDR. The client must sign this with Freighter and submit to the Stellar network.

ScValResponse.description: Raw Soroban ScVal result returned from on-chain contract queries.

HealthFactorResponse.description: Loan health factor response. Values ≥ 10 000 indicate a healthy loan; values < 10 000 indicate the loan is eligible for liquidation.

WebhookRecord.description: A registered webhook endpoint that receives event notifications via HTTP POST.

url.description: HTTPS URL receiving webhook POST requests.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the webhook was registered.

WebhookLog.description: Record of a webhook delivery attempt, including the event type, HTTP response status, and timestamp.

webhookId.description: ID of the webhook that was called.

event.description: Event type that triggered the delivery (e.g. loan_created, loan_repaid).

status.description: HTTP status code returned by the webhook endpoint.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the delivery attempt.

TransactionRecord.description: A recorded on-chain or off-chain transaction in the StellarKraal system.

borrower.description: Stellar public key of the borrower involved.

amount.description: Transaction amount in token base units.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the transaction was recorded.

TransactionPage.description: Paginated response containing a list of transaction records with total count and pagination metadata.

data.description: Array of transaction records for the current page.

total.description: Total number of transaction records matching the query.

UserSettings.description: User preferences including notification settings, language, and currency. Stored per wallet address.

walletAddress.description: Stellar public key associated with these settings.

joinDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the user first configured settings.

loanApproved.description: Notify when a loan request is approved.

loanRepaid.description: Notify when a loan repayment is confirmed.

liquidationWarning.description: Notify when a loan approaches liquidation threshold.

language.description: Preferred language code (e.g. en, es, fr).

currency.description: Preferred display currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, KES).

UserSettingsUpdate.description: Partial update request for user settings. Only provided fields are applied.

loanApproved.description: Notify when a loan request is approved.

loanRepaid.description: Notify when a loan repayment is confirmed.

liquidationWarning.description: Notify when a loan approaches liquidation threshold.

DeletedResponse.description: Confirmation returned after a successful soft-delete operation.

id.description: ID of the record that was soft-deleted.

RestoredResponse.description: Confirmation returned after a successful restore operation.

id.description: ID of the record that was restored.

totalUsers.description: Count of unique users (collateral owners + borrowers)

totalCollateral.description: Total number of collateral items registered

totalValueLocked.description: Sum of all collateral appraised values in XLM

activeLoansCount.description: Count of loans with status 'active' or 'at_risk'

RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed in the current window

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Number of requests remaining in the current window

RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the rate limit window resets

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (present on 429 responses only)

example.message: Rate limit exceeded. Please retry after 60 seconds.
